How to play Ludo King:
The objective of the game is pretty straightforward; each player gets 4 tokens, these tokens must make a full turn of the board and then make it to the finish line. Whoever gets all four tokens to the end first is the winner. However, each move can only be made based on the number decided by casting a six-sided die, and each token can only move out of their home by casting a six. Additionally, the competition factor of the games is upped by the fact that while moving if another player’s token lands on the same square as your token, then your token will automatically be sent back home and you’ll need to roll a six again.

Another nostalgic game similar in structure is Snakes and Ladders. Ludo King now incorporates this classic game as a whole new level. The objective of the game is simple: you start on 1 and you have to be the first one to make it to 100. However, you can only move the same number of tiles as the number you roll on a die. As the name suggests, the board is also littered with snakes and ladders. If you land on the same tile as the beginning of a ladder, then you can take the ladder as a shortcut and move on up. But if you land on the mouth of a snake, then down you go to its tail. A game of ups and down, Snakes and Ladders has been a favorite for generations; and now you can play it too, with Ludo King.

This mobile gaming gem blends breathtaking graphics, dynamic animations, and immersive stadiums to create the most authentic cricket experience ever. Get ready for sharp deliveries, heart-pounding catches, and the roar of the crowd - Sachin Saga Pro Cricket game will transport you to the heart of the action! 

Feel the tension rise as Nick Knight's masterful English commentary dissects every strategic move, while Nikhil Chopra's passionate Hindi calls ignite the stadium atmosphere. Sachin Saga Pro Cricket - where every cricketing moment resonates. 

Step onto the pitch and unleash your inner Sachin! Choose from a wide variety of shots, time your deliveries to perfection, and launch thunderous sixes or score clever singles.  

Sachin Saga Pro Cricket features include: 
Legends Journey - The game introduces the Career Mode of Master Blaster Sachin Tendulkar in 3 phases focusing on different stages of Sachin’s life. 
1. Boy Wonder – highlights the early action of Sachin Tendulkar where he displayed his phenomenal performance as a beginner in domestic & international matches. 
2. Master Blaster – offers the stage matches where he became a cricketing symbol & still is. 
3. Legends era – a collection of high-quality matches where he exhibited his best form & gave exceptional victorious moments & rose as a God of Cricket 
 
Single Player –  
1. Players will be able to customize matches w.r.t. Weather, pitch, stadiums, no. of overs & time of day. 
2. Players can pick & play in International Cricket matches & Premier League matches. 
3. Earn various rewards & collect different cricket trophies to your collection. 
 
Gallery – Along with Sachin’s golden era of marvellous career, we have Sachin’s Gallery. A collection of inconceivable, unique & prestigious achievements throughout his career. Players can play different modes and unlock items 
 
Multiplayer – Build your own dream team. Collect Gold, Silver & Bronze players from the pack, create your strong team & compete against other users in different tours for various rewards. 
 

This cricket game is entirely free to download and play!
